misc: Known for bomb drives despite his advanced age.
Finally made his first hole-in-one on May 24th, 2025, after 20 years of trying.
biography: Harri, representing Hattula Golf, is set to make his seventh appearance in the esteemed Hector Trophée 2026. His consistent involvement in this unique pair competition, spanning six previous editions, underscores a profound and enduring commitment to the sport, firmly establishing him as a venerable figure on its championship greens.

Throughout his tenure, Harri has demonstrated an exceptional aptitude for the team format, culminating in two triumphant victories in the coveted Hector Trophée. These successes highlight his ability to forge formidable partnerships and perform under pressure. While his collective achievements are notable, the individual Victor Trophy has, to date, remained an elusive aspiration, presenting a distinct personal challenge.

Affectionately known as "the doctor," Harri defies expectations on the course, consistently delivering powerful "bomb drives" that belie his advanced age. A significant personal milestone was achieved on May 24th, 2025, when he finally celebrated his first career hole-in-one after a remarkable two decades of relentless effort, a testament to his persistent dedication and passion for the game.

As Harri prepares for his next venture onto the Hector Trophée greens, he remains an active and formidable competitor. Spectators will undoubtedly watch with keen interest, eager to see if this seasoned champion can add another illustrious chapter to his already distinguished Hector Trophée legacy, perhaps even completing his set of major tournament honors.
